title: Certificate
purpose: Record a certificate your laboratory holds (Add certificate), or change one already listed (Edit). The certificate is printed as recorded; results are never checked against it.
summary: Record a certificate your laboratory holds, or change one already listed. Reports print it as you record it.

tasks.title: Record a certificate
steps: Enter the [[Issuing authority]] and the [[Certificate or laboratory ID]].
Add the [[Valid from]] and [[Valid until]] dates if the certificate has them.
Tick [[Print on reports]] if reports should list it, and save.

tasks.title: Change the order on reports
steps: Set [[List position]]. Lower numbers are listed first.

good_to_know: A certificate marked for printing is left off reports issued outside its validity dates.
Results are never checked against a certificate. It is printed as recorded.
Remove a certificate from the Laboratory profile, not from this form.
A laboratory can list at most 50 certificates.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin laboratory role can open or submit this form. Surrounding spaces are removed from the text fields.

items.label: Issuing authority
items.description: Required, up to 160 characters. The body that issued the certificate.

items.label: Program or scope
items.description: Optional, up to 160 characters. The program, matrix or scope named on the certificate. It is printed as entered; the application keeps no register of what a certificate covers.

items.label: Certificate or laboratory ID
items.description: Required, up to 80 characters. The number the authority assigned.

items.label: Valid from, Valid until
items.description: Optional dates. Both dates count as valid, and a blank date sets no limit on that side. Valid until cannot be earlier than Valid from.

items.label: Print on reports
items.description: Unchecked by default. When checked, the certificate is printed on reports issued within its validity dates and left off reports issued outside them.

items.label: List position
items.description: A whole number, 0 by default. Certificates are listed lowest first, then by issuing authority.

items.label: Add certificate / Save changes
items.description: Saves and returns to the Laboratory profile. Each addition and change is audited with the values before and after, and applies to reports issued from then on. An unchanged submission returns with No changes to save. A laboratory can list at most 50 certificates.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the Laboratory profile without saving.

items.label: Changed by someone else
items.description: If the certificate changed after you opened the form, saving is refused and your input stays on the form; reload and compare the current values before saving again. If it was removed, the form is not found.

items.label: Removing
items.description: Done from the Certificates table on the Laboratory profile, not from this form.
